description: Rust Boil rebuild three (8 clean needed): wave7 proved the form exists in-model (perfect blister-mounds rendered as background scenery while the subject went vertical-figure). Levers: ASPECT-RATIO language (low and wide, twice as wide as tall — every failure went vertical), the hole noun deleted entirely (it painted open voids; the crown is only ever a taut tallow disc), flat-ground fusion only (banks invited grip-fingers). Fresh seeds.
style_prefix: hand-painted oil-and-ink creature concept art, muted peat-and-tallow palette, soft charcoal outlines, one warm tallow light in cold fen gloom, grim folkloric, matte painterly texture
